recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3504; any future wording improvement about extensions on Extension.value[x] should be tracked separately rather than changing this resolved root Extension rule.
issue_request: FHIR-3504 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core extensibility change request asking whether an Extension may have both value[x] and child extensions; its accepted resolution was to clarify the specification by adding that an extension has either a value or child extensions, but not both.
initial_application: The requested narrative appears to have been applied by 1902100d7d on 2015-03-15, which inserted the 'but not both' wording into source/extensibility.html. The source later gained the corresponding Extension invariant in ae218b8ca5 on 2016-07-17, adding 'Must have either extensions or value[x], not both' with FHIRPath and XPath expressions. Later editorial and refactoring commits preserved the rule.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Extension as an active infrastructure type and maps the Extension type page to extensibility, so the checked source/extensibility.html narrative and source/datatypes/extension.xml datatype spreadsheet are current build inputs. Later Zulip implementer threads clarify that extensions may appear inside the value[x] element itself, but that does not allow the root Extension to carry both value[x] and child extensions. Confluence/Jira/community searches found no later conflicting core decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no source edit is needed: source/extensibility.html already contains the requested narrative clarification and source/datatypes/extension.xml already enforces the rule as a datatype invariant.
